results.criterion: AC1: The actual `migrate-subprojects-plan` CLI preserves stdout mode and supports exclusive `--output PATH`; saving never overwrites an existing file or changes source records.
results.observation: Actual plan CLI saves an exclusive JSON file and rejects existing files and symlink aliases without changing their bytes.

results.criterion: AC2: A fixed snapshot and assignments produce an identical versioned plan and digest containing all recomputation inputs, complete legacy inventory, existing owners, ProjectEntry and live-reference hashes, target preconditions, candidate hashes and intended write scope.
results.observation: Planner/recompute and rehashed-candidate rejection regressions verify deterministic hashes and complete input guards.

results.criterion: AC3: Declared ancestry determines owners. Explicit assignments resolve ambiguous ownership; cycles, dangling/conflicting parents and destination collisions remain explicit blockers rather than inferred prose decisions.
results.observation: Owner ancestry, explicit orphan assignments, malformed assignment rejection, collisions and independent Spec review cover owner selection without prose inference.

results.criterion: AC4: Rewrites cover ancestry/dependency metadata and supported live Markdown links, reference links and images outside code fences, including active inbound references and Project/owner indexes. Links resolve to the intended final identities; unsupported live forms are reported as blockers.
results.observation: Nested notes, surgical inbound metadata, plain/angle/wiki/HTML handling, actual mixed-owner dependency migration and final link resolution passed.

results.criterion: AC5: Existing canonical shared local IDs and lifecycle decisions are retained. Legacy shared identity metadata is deterministic; unrelated content, historical evidence and logs remain byte-identical.
results.observation: Canonical shared ID migration-authority is retained; historical evidence/log bytes and existing owner PRD bytes were compared before and after actual migration.

results.criterion: AC6: Plans include proposal fingerprint disposition and bound/unbound STATUS inputs without installing adapters, creating bindings, approving records or manufacturing completion authority.
results.observation: Bound STATUS is pinned and rendered from final paths; foreign identity metadata is rejected; proposal fingerprint classification is reviewed without inherited approval.

results.criterion: AC7: Focused behavior regressions and an actual CLI smoke prove the preceding criteria; saved plan schema and command documentation are updated and reviewed.
results.observation: 48 focused migration/audit checks and the 15-module suite passed; both independent review axes approved; consumer CLI knowledge and procedure docs updated.
